comment: GoldenNugget HotLoad safety rules. Each rule flags a tweak (by its TweakID name) as dangerous/broken, or a whole feature with action "hide_feature". A rule is ACTIVE when 'disabled' is not present or is true; set 'disabled': false to temporarily remove the flag without deleting the rule. Scoping fields: 'app_versions' (exact set, e.g. ["9.2"]), 'min_app_version'/'max_app_version' (range) — which GoldenNugget builds the rule applies to; 'min_version'/'max_version' — iOS version range; 'only_models' — device prefixes. Rules with the special action "kill_app" act as a REMOTE KILL SWITCH: on matching versions/models GoldenNugget refuses to start (or, if already running, shuts itself down like a crash). Scope such rules as narrowly as possible. Rules with action "hide_feature" (field 'feature': one of "Liquid Glass", "Springboard", "Internal", "PosterBoard", "Daemons", "Status Bar", "Templates") hide the whole feature on matching setups: its tweaks disappear from the UI, the Sidebar button and iOS home card are hidden, it is never applied, and presets refuse to load it.

rules.reason: The Voice Control daemons (assistant_service / assistantd / voiced) cause a bootloop when disabled on current iOS. GoldenNugget 9.2 still ships Voice Control in the daemons list, so enabling Daemons is dangerous on 9.2 builds. 9.2.1+ hard-blocks Voice Control in code.
Example rule (inert): a version-scoped daemons flag.
Example rule (inert): GoldenNugget fully disabled on iOS 27.x until a fix ships.
Example rule (inert): the whole Liquid Glass feature is hidden on iPhone 15 until a fix ships.
